old_block = '''        if args.bump is None:
            createparser().parse_args(["bump", "--help"])
        
        func = getattr(ver, maptable[args.bump])'''

new_block = '''        if args.bump is None:
            try:
                createparser().parse_args(["bump", "--help"])
            except SystemExit:
                pass
            return 0
        func = getattr(ver, maptable[args.bump])'''
